fields.description: Unique session identifier (primary key). Generated by the engine per player start.
fields.label: Session ID

fields.description: State-machine status. Drives what the engine does with the next incoming message.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
NEW
WAITING_START
WAITING_BUSINESS_TYPE
WAITING_COMPANY_SIZE
PLAYING
WAITING_ANSWER
CALCULATING
COMPLETED
REPORT_SENT
DEMO_REQUESTED
CONVERTED
ABANDONED

fields.description: Which challenge this session is playing.
fields.label: Challenge

fields.description: Challenge version captured at start, for traceability.
fields.label: Challenge Version

fields.description: The question_number the player is currently on. Used to resume after a break.
fields.label: Current Question

fields.description: Player mobile number (digits with country code).
fields.label: Mobile Number

fields.description: WhatsApp id the messages arrive from (usually equals the mobile number).
fields.label: WhatsApp ID

fields.description: Player name (from their WhatsApp profile or captured during onboarding).
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: Business sector the player selected before gameplay.
fields.label: Business Type

fields.description: Business size the player selected before gameplay.
fields.label: Company Size

fields.description: Company name, if provided.
fields.label: Company Name

fields.description: Final overall score, computed as the simple average of the six indicators.
fields.label: Total Score

fields.description: The player's gameplay performance score. Same as total_score; kept as a distinct field to stay clearly separate from lead_score.
fields.label: Challenge Score

fields.description: Lead quality score (0-100). Computed from qualification answers/behaviour. NOT the same as the challenge score.
fields.label: Lead Score

fields.description: Lead quality band derived from lead_score.
fields.label: Lead Quality

fields.description: The ERPNext Lead created for this session, if any.
fields.label: Lead

fields.description: Where the player came from, e.g. Instagram, TikTok, QR, Website, Referral.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Campaign identifier captured from the entry link, if any.
fields.label: Campaign

fields.description: Referral code this player arrived with, if any (reserved for a later phase).
fields.label: Referral Code

fields.description: Every answer the player gave, in order.
fields.label: Answers
